scripts.db:shell: wrangler d1 execute quiz-db --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name" --remote
scripts.db:count: wrangler d1 execute quiz-db --command="SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions) AS sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q_state) AS q_state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mock_log) AS mock_log" --remote
scripts.db:sub: wrangler d1 execute quiz-db --command="SELECT u.email, s.subject, s.status, s.plan_key, datetime(s.expire_at,'unixepoch','localtime') AS expire_at, s.source FROM subscriptions s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 30" --remote
scripts.db:orders: wrangler d1 execute quiz-db --command="SELECT u.email, p.custom_id, p.plan_key, p.status, p.activate_mode, datetime(p.created_at,'unixepoch','localtime') AS created_at, p.last_error FROM pending_orders p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 30" --remote
scripts.secret:afdian: wrangler secret put AFDIAN_USER_ID && wrangler secret put AFDIAN_TOKEN
scripts.test: node tests/pepper.test.mjs && node tests/subscription.test.mjs && node tests/http.test.mjs && node tests/sync.test.mjs
scripts.setup: npm run db:init && npm run secret:pepper
scripts.redeploy: npm run deploy && npm run logs
